description: Downloads the raw file content of one Rich Page attachment. Images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) come back as image content, UTF-8 text files as text, and any other file (PDF, Office, ZIP) as an embedded base64 resource; files over 20 MB are refused. Use this only when you need the file's bytes; for its metadata (fileName, contentType, size, author) call `getPageAttachment`, and to discover attachment IDs call `getPageAttachments`.

attachmentId.description: The attachment's ID, as returned by the corresponding list- or get-attachments call for this resource.

pageName.description: The Rich Page's ID/name within its space — its stable identifier, not its display title.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

revision.description: A specific repository revision (e.g. `1234`) to read the resource as it existed at that revision instead of the current HEAD. Omit to use the latest revision.

spaceId.description: The Document Space ID (a folder-like grouping of documents/pages within a project). Use `_default` (no quotes) to address the project's default space.

name: getPageAttachmentContent
